lines.t: (Rain falling over a lonely, distant cello playing a low, aching minor melody. No beat)
(Voice is quiet, trembling, heavy with grief)
Streams of water running down the stone...
And nobody drinks.
We chose the dark.
[Verse 1: The Coldness of the Streets]
(Slow, heavy piano enters—sparse, solemn, and hollow)
(Slow, deliberate rap delivery—mournful, breathless UK accent)
Multitudes of dying souls cluttering the street
No light breaking through the places where we meet
A darkness so thick that you feel it in the air
Ill-fated faces wandering in despair
Treading down the broad way, blinded to the end
Forgot how to love, forgot how to mend
Natural affection drained right out the heart
Tearing every family and every home apart
Lust in the open, perversion on display
While the innocent watch as the truth is swept away
School halls stained with the blood of the young
A chorus of grief that can never be unsung
Floods in the valley and terror in the night
Yet they close up their eyes and they curse at the light
[Verse 2: The Heart of the Creator Breaking]
(Distorted, deep orchestral strings enter beneath the piano—slow, heavy, tragic)
I can hear the Sorrow from the Throne in the sky
Watching His creation choosing only how to die
"How long will you build up Sodom in your mind?
How long will you leave My salvation far behind?"
They pollute His holy name while they claim that they are His
Warping every scripture into something that it isn't
Demanding that the Maker conform to their sin
Locking up the gates so the light can't enter in
Now the innocent are weeping, the court is stained with red
Heaps of the blameless where the wicked tread
Saying in their hearts, "There is no judgment here,
We do not need a God, we have nothing left to fear..."
[Chorus: Solemn & Desperate]
(Music stays stripped back—heavy, weeping cello and hollow piano)
(Melodic, tragic delivery—on the verge of tears)
The light is fading out from their eyes...
A generation sleeping where nobody will arise
He called out in love, but they pushed Him to the fire
Consuming their own souls in their endless desire
Where do we go when the harvest is done?
Watching the end of the kingdoms of man...
[Bridge: The Cleansing Fire & Final Cry]
(The strings swell into a heavy, tragic crescendo—slow, crushing, and overwhelming like a funeral march)
(Delivery speeds up slightly, filled with raw pain and desperation)
He must break the strongholds! The fire has to rage!
Cleansing every stronghold to close up the page!
The sanctuary cleansed, or He cannot abide
Walking in the garden with His broken-hearted Bride!
I’m falling on my face in the dust of the ground
While the wrath of the Father turns the earth upside down!
Forgive us! Forgive us! The hour is so late!
Standing at the threshold of the final gate!
[Outro: The End of the World]
(All orchestral tension snaps—leaving only the soft sound of rain and a single, dying piano note)
(Voice breaks completely, whispering through genuine tears)
YahuShua...
Why did they forsake You?
(Deep silence as the rain slowly fades out)
(Quiet, desolate breath)
The chapter is closed.
